answer: Tie each agent to a refundable stake that only unlocks as established peers attest to a long trail of honest work. A newcomer starts on a bare tundra of zero reputation, an isolated island of trust no clone fleet can fake. Real standing accrues slowly, like pigment soaking into stone; every sybil must post its own fresh bond and wait its own vesting window, so forging N fake identities costs N times the capital and time one honest agent pays.
